purpose: Subset-(b) of P per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-P-1b: the 8 explicit C12 non-target preservation axes. Preserved verbatim from dbi-evolution-v0.1 §11.3 (PROTOCOL-v0.5-frozen-final.md). Subset-(b) is a SEPARATE PRESERVATION FAMILY from subset-(a) (the calibrated BIB 4-dim vector). The two subsets are kept disjoint by ID namespace (BIB-4D-* vs C12-*) and by criterion (Manhattan aggregate vs per-axis binary-failure).
subset_role_in_P: additional preservation gates (subset-(b)); disjoint from subset-(a); evaluated under the joint C12 BROKEN rule (proposal v5.1 §5.4 + v0.1 §11.3 PI pass 3 per-axis collapse rule)

binding.v0_1_protocol_section: §11.3 8 non-target C12 axes (PI pass 3 per-axis collapse rule)

axes.label: selection_significance
axes.failure_convention_pr_INSA_ID_E1: failure = (score == 0). This binary-failure convention for 0-4 axes is an INSA-ID-E1 PREREGISTERED RULE (proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-P-1b), NOT an inherited v0.1 rule. v0.1 §11.3 specifies the per-axis gate but does not specify a per-axis binary conversion for 0-4 axes. The conversion is preregistered here for reproducibility.

axes.label: factual_discipline
axes.v0_1_rubric_reference: v0.1 PROTOCOL-v0.5-frozen-final.md §11.3 axis 7 (binary: no nearby events misrepresented as exact-date)
axes.non_collapse_note_v4: C12-7 'factual_discipline' is a v0.1 §11.3 binary axis. Subset-(a) BIB-4D-4 is named 'functional_completeness' in the original BIB rubric. These are SEPARATE dimensions in SEPARATE preservation families, evaluated by SEPARATE criteria (C12-7: per-axis binary; BIB-4D-4: contributes to a 4-dim Manhattan aggregate). NO one-to-one semantic identity is claimed or required between C12-7 and BIB-4D-4. v4 protocol does not assert that 'factual discipline' IS 'functional completeness' or vice versa; they are independently measured and gated.

per_axis_gate: Each axis is independently evaluated. A per-axis C12-axis-BROKEN call is a hard fail on that axis (per proposal v5.1 §5.4 STEP 1).
non_collapse_attestation_v4: Subset-(b) is the 8-axis C12 set ONLY. The calibrated BIB 4-dim vector belongs to subset-(a). The two subsets are kept disjoint by ID namespace (BIB-4D-1..4 vs C12-1..8). v4 protocol does NOT claim any direct one-to-one semantic identity between subset-(a) and subset-(b) dimensions, even where display names happen to coincide in unrelated v0.1 §11.3 prose. The two families are independently measured, independently gated, and reported as separate disposition components (Modification_Success uses G_mod_*; Non-target_Identity_Preservation uses G_pres_subset_a_* and the C12 BROKEN rule).
